meta.purpose: P2607 is NGPL Sabine Pass Compression Project, not Transco: name, owner and EIA cost; P0145 Access South owner to Texas Eastern and an open length question

values.PipelineName: Natural Gas Pipeline Company of America System

resolutions.primary_value: Natural Gas Pipeline Company of America System

verifications.note: FERC's environmental assessment for docket CP18-487, issued in 2019. It describes the Sabine Pass Compression Project of Natural Gas Pipeline Company of America LLC in Louisiana. It does not mention Transcontinental.

A Kinder Morgan earnings release from October 2020, saved by the Wayback Machine. It says construction is complete on NGPL's Sabine Pass Compression Project, placed in service on October 1, 2020, at about $68 million.

The EIA pipeline projects list for August 2026 has the Sabine Pass Compression Project under Natural Gas Pipeline Co of America (Nat Gas P L Co of America): completed October 1, 2020, Louisiana, docket CP18-487, cost 65.9 million dollars, 400 million cubic feet a day, 36 inch.

resolutions.researcher_notes: This row is filed under the Transcontinental (Transco) system, but the project belongs to Natural Gas Pipeline Company of America (NGPL), a Kinder Morgan pipeline. The FERC environmental assessment, a Kinder Morgan earnings release and the EIA projects list all name NGPL as the company that built it. No source ties it to Transco. The row moves to the NGPL system row's name and wiki page, P0222. The same kind of fix was made for P7814.

verifications.note: The Spectra Energy Partners page for the Access South Project, saved by the Wayback Machine in July 2018. It gives ownership as 100% Texas Eastern Transmission, LP, FERC docket CP16-3-000 and capacity of 320,000 dekatherms a day.

A Federal Register notice from October 28, 2015 on FERC docket CP16-3-000. Texas Eastern Transmission, LP applied to build the Access South, Adair Southwest and Lebanon Extension projects, including about 15.8 miles of 36-inch pipeline at three places in Ohio.

resolutions.researcher_notes: The owner cell named Enbridge Inc, which is a parent company. The Spectra Energy Partners project page gives ownership as 100% Texas Eastern Transmission, LP. A Federal Register notice names Texas Eastern as the company that applied to build the project. The Operator cell already names Texas Eastern Transmission LP.

verifications.note: A Federal Register notice from October 28, 2015 on FERC docket CP16-3-000. Texas Eastern Transmission, LP applied to build the Access South, Adair Southwest and Lebanon Extension projects, including about 15.8 miles of 36-inch pipeline at three places in Ohio.

A Federal Register notice from May 23, 2016 on FERC dockets CP16-3-000 and CP16-3-001. The three projects together include 15.8 miles of 36-inch pipeline loop in three segments in Athens, Meigs, Noble and Monroe Counties, Ohio, and 0.5 mile of 16-inch replacement pipe in Attala County, Mississippi.

resolutions.researcher_notes: The sheet length of 1287 km has no source. It is about 800 miles, close to the distance along the existing Texas Eastern line from Uniontown, Pennsylvania to Kosciusko, Mississippi. Access South mostly reversed flow on that existing line and added compression. FERC notices say Access South, Adair Southwest and Lebanon Extension together built 15.8 miles of 36-inch loop in Ohio and 0.5 mile of replacement pipe in Mississippi. No source found splits that new pipe by project. Searched: the Spectra project page, two Federal Register notices on docket CP16-3, the EIA projects list (which gives no miles) and web searches. A person should decide whether the row carries the existing line length or only new pipe.
